name: Lunille
description: A notch app for Mac built around Luni, a little moon behind the camera that reacts to your music, AirPods and the weather, with music, calls and a file tray.
terms: No code, applied at checkout. One-time for up to 3 Macs, updates included. $14.99 from Dec 1. 14-day free trial, no account. macOS 14+, universal.
